_noteP: P (Gift of the Drowned Ones) investigated (prior session, first real trace) and found GENUINELY BLOCKED: no direct-damage calc exists in the passive at all. PykePassive.mSpell.mSpellCalculations has exactly 3 entries: 'DamageStorageMax' = NumberCalculationPart(80.0) + StatByNamedDataValueCalculationPart(mStat=2, mStatFormula=2 -> bonus AD, mDataValue='DamageStoreMaxBonusADRatio') -- this is the CAP on how much 'gray health' Pyke can bank from damage he deals, not a hit Pyke deals; 'OneEnemyCalc' = NamedDataValueCalculationPart('OneEnemy'=0.09) + StatByCoefficientCalculationPart(mStat=29, mCoefficient=0.002); 'AdditionalBonusCalc' = NamedDataValueCalculationPart('AdditionalBonus'=0.40) + StatByCoefficientCalculationPart(mStat=29, mCoefficient=0.004) -- both mDisplayAsPercent:true and both are the HEAL-CONVERSION percentages (how much of the banked gray health is restored as an actual heal on a takedown, single-target vs. multi-target/assist), not damage output. None of these three calcs produce a hit; the passive's entire mechanic is store-damage-as-gray-health then convert-to-heal, which the SkillHit schema has no shape for (it models additive damage hits, not heal-conversion percentages). Independently, mStat=29 (used by both OneEnemyCalc and AdditionalBonusCalc, and again by R below) is not one of the mapped ids in SkillDamage.BuildStatResolver (0=AP,1=Armor,2=AD,6=MR,7=MS,12=HP) and would throw KeyNotFoundException even if these WERE damage.
